name: The Taste of Freedom 2
source:
You've tasted freedom! ......Now what?

Reunite with Milk Chocolate, Sour Cream & Onion Chip, and Raspberry Scone in this sequel of whimsical yet dark visual novel!

Except that those weren't their real names.

Maybe they were never humanized snacks after all. They're all just humans, hiding behind names that were never meant to last...

[From [url=https://asterisksrn.itch.io/the-taste-of-freedom-2]itch.io[/url]]
